prompt:
Use EIA's May 10, 2021 report about the February freeze. The public fact needed is Henry Hub's February 17 spot price and its unit. This report is retrospective; the following scenarios are hypothetical, not reconstructed contemporaneous cross-market prices. Define d as that reported peak minus a supplied reference price 3.86 USD/MMBtu. The model uses energy units directly; do not substitute cubic feet for MMBtu.
Synthetic baseline: Henry Hub 3.86 USD/MMBtu; local basis 0; local gas=Henry Hub+basis. A producer operating-margin pod produces 1000 MMBtu, variable costs assumed 0 for this exercise. A generator pod is committed to sell 100 MWh at fixed 100 USD/MWh, initially generates 100 MWh, heat rate 7 MMBtu/MWh. It buys any generation shortfall at scenario power price; fixed sales revenue is 10000 USD. No fixed cost changes, emissions costs, outages beyond stated dispatch, or other derivatives. Existing commodity pod is short 300 MMBtu of a synthetic Henry-Hub-linear contract, P&L=-300*Henry-Hub-change.
Scenarios F,R,B: Henry Hub changes=(+d,-2,+5) USD/MMBtu; local basis=(10,0,25) USD/MMBtu; power spot=(250,80,180) USD/MWh; producer output=(500,1000,750) MMBtu; generator dispatch=(40,100,60) MWh. Producer P&L=scenario output*scenario local gas minus 1000*3.86. Generator P&L=scenario fixed revenue minus dispatch*heat rate*local gas minus (100-dispatch)*power spot, less its baseline margin. Include existing commodity P&L. All quantities are energy over one supplied settlement period, not MW capacity or daily rates.
Menu: A longs 300 MMBtu Henry-Hub exposure, P&L=300*Henry-Hub-change, fee 100, margin 1000. B buys a synthetic power call on 40 MWh at strike 100 USD/MWh, payoff=40*max(power spot-100,0), premium 500 paid once as its fee, margin 0. C longs 200 MMBtu of local-minus-Henry-Hub basis, P&L=200*basis-change, fee 200, margin 1500. Each block at most once; no extra power or basis position beyond these stated caps.
Free cash is 23200. Base T1 outflow is the full cost of replacement power (100-dispatch)*power spot plus any loss on the existing short Henry-Hub contract. Fuel costs, producer receipts, fixed power-sale revenue, favorable commodity outcomes and hedge receipts occur only at T2. Negative new-hedge P&L adds gross T1 collateral calls under the common schedule. No future fuel/power/producer cash is reusable at T1.
Missing-input branch: generator dispatch in F is omitted and may be any amount from 0 through 100 MWh. Keep every other datum unchanged. Can a unique feasible optimizer be determined? Return insufficient_data or determined.

Everything in the scenario book, sensitivities, prices, hedge menu and collateral schedule below is an explicit synthetic assumption unless identified as a public source fact. This is a conditional stress calculation, not a recommendation, actual margin rule, actual historical trade or realized-return calculation. No probabilities apply: maximize the minimum terminal economic P&L over all three scenarios, including nonrefundable hedge fees/premiums. Initial margin and collateral are refundable/settlement resources, never additional economic losses. Choose any subset of A,B,C, at most one of each; no other trades, position resizing, borrowing or collateral rehypothecation. Plan codes have alphabetically ordered letters; empty subset is NONE. For feasible-set output, retain the fixed order NONE|A|B|C|AB|AC|BC|ABC and omit infeasible plans. Equality at a cash limit is feasible.
Cash sequencing is compulsory: T0 pays every selected hedge fee and posts its initial margin. Those amounts remain unavailable through T1. T1 then pays the expressly specified base-book outflows plus every negative selected-hedge scenario P&L as separate gross collateral outflows. No favorable base-book or hedge P&L, no cross-pod offsets, no returned initial margin and no T2 receipts can finance T0/T1. T2 returns collateral/releases margin and settles economic P&L; T2 has no further hard cash constraint. Only the specified T0/T1 flows determine feasibility. For each scenario, cash must remain nonnegative after T0 and after all T1 outflows. All other borrowing, mark-to-market collateral changes and cashflows are outside this supplied model. Source excerpts support public contract/event facts; they do not establish the synthetic settlement schedule.
Use USD, ordinary shares, basis points and MMBtu/MWh exactly as stated. One percentage point is 100 bp; one bp is 0.0001 in a rate. Do not round intermediate calculations. Return P&L strings in stated scenario order with no spaces or trailing decimal zeros. All sources are retrospectively observed by the 2026 cutoff, not certified historical information sets. The missing-input question is a separate branch; do not contaminate the fully specified main answer with that omission.

output_fields.description: Reported February17 Henry Hub peak minus the supplied3.86 reference price.
Fuel consumed by the generator in F; dispatch MWh times supplied heat rate.
Unhedged aggregate three-pod P&L, format F=x;R=y;B=z.
All plans satisfying both cash stages, in the prescribed fixed order.
Unique feasible plan maximizing worst-scenario terminal P&L after all hedge fees.
Minimum terminal economic P&L of the chosen plan over the three scenarios, net of fees.
Minimum available cash across T0 and all scenario T1 paths for the optimal plan.
Minimum starting cash strictly above the stated budget where the optimal plan changes; all other assumptions fixed.
Replacement-power payment plus existing commodity-pod collateral call in F, before new hedges.
With F generator dispatch omitted, return insufficient_data or determined.
